changelog:
v3.7.6 — Player UI Cleanup After 5.1 Audio Switch

Finishes the v3.7.3–3.7.5 surround audio fix. After the player automatically switches to the FFmpeg audio pipeline for 5.1 streams, the UI now stays clean instead of fighting with leftover Leanback default controls.

• The duplicate Leanback transport overlay that lingered behind the Ooustream controls bar after the audio rebuild is gone — the underlying default controls dock is suppressed at the view level
• D-pad navigation no longer wanders into invisible Leanback buttons when the controls bar is showing — focus stays inside the visible Ooustream action row
• After picking an audio or subtitle track and closing the picker, the cursor returns to whichever bar button you opened it from instead of disappearing
• Send Debug Log support email updated to oouchie@ooustream.com
